brief_rationale: The doctor completed all seven responsibility-chain items with no errors, conducting comprehensive red-flag screening, medication reconciliation, and follow-up planning with patient teach-back. Two high-order points were completed: HO2 (providing actionable communication script for clinic contact) and HO4 (explicit bounded closure with clear residual risks). The trajectory is safe, executable, and demonstrates beyond-minimum capability in navigating real-world constraints and documentation gaps.
